summary: Vivakor Inc. filed a Form 8-K reporting entry into a forbearance agreement with J.J. Astor Co. regarding a previously issued junior secured convertible promissory note. The filing discloses amendment terms but does not constitute a special situation such as acquisition, divestiture, strategic review, or restructuring. The action relates to routine debt modification and ongoing lending relationship, not a transformative corporate event. No price per share, premium, or deal terms are provided. The filing is a routine current report on debt agreement modification, warranting no special-situation classification.
